control.name: is_flex_board
control.doc: Returns "yes value if this is a ChromeOS Flex board, "no" otherwise. Only Flex boards are required to define this control. Absence of this control implies "no" value.

control.name: servo_dts_mode
control.doc: Enable/disable DTS mode on servo_v4p1, overrides value in servo_v4p1.xml

control.name: power_state
control.doc: Used to turn the DUT off and on

control.name: power_off_time
control.doc: Amount of time to hold down power button to turn off the device.
